name: Can Shen Juexing
source:
Cultists in black robes prayed loudly under the moon, and indescribable horrors fell from the sky. In the world that ordinary people cannot perceive, a huge storm that can destroy the world is brewing! "If you don't want this city to be in ruins, let me stay here for one night." Seeing the girl in black who forcibly broke into her house, Mikage Du couldn't understand the meaning of her words at this fashion.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2011240/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
身穿黑袍的教徒们在月下大声祈祷，难以形容的恐怖从天而降。在常人无法感知的世界里，一场足以毁灭世界的巨大风暴正在酝酿！“如果你不想让这座城市成为废墟，就让我在这里住一晚吧。”看到强行闯入自己家中的黑衣少女，御影都无法理解她这番话的意思。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2011240/]Steam[/url]]
